_comment: Default configuration for the forms addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_form_submit: Who may submit a form is decided by the page it is on: the page's front matter `access: { form-submit: [...] }` when it states one, else site policy. This policy grants form-submit to every built-in role, anonymous included, which keeps forms open as they always were. A deployment narrows it in app-custom-config.json, adds its own roles, or sets a rule per page. Code never names a role.

form-submit.description: Submit a form on a page; the page's own access rules can narrow it

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Submit forms
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Anyone may submit a form, unless the page it is on says otherwise
